'''Alberto Montelli''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] whose voice is first heard during {{Quest|Through the Sea Thou Break}}. He has not yet made a full appearance.

==Profile==
A member of the [[Montelli Family]], Alberto is the head of the [[Averardo Vault]], and the boss of [[Zani]], who describes him as cautious and not one to make outright promises unless pressured by higher-ups in the family.
